The comparable UTI scheme on the same index is ALSO missing its 2026-07 snapshot in both nidp.scanx_mf_holdings and nidp.mf_holdings_monthly (verified) -- a pre-existing July collection gap shared across sources, not evidence against ScanX specifically.
